headerDisplay: Talks to the Advantage Air **e-zone** tablet on your local network (the MyPlace app's API, port 2025). Give the tablet a fixed IP address in your router.
footerDisplay: Apple Home shows one **Air Conditioner** tile (heat, cool, fan only, dry), one tile per zone and a **Sleep Timer**. Move each zone tile into its room in the Home app.

sleepTimerMinutes.title: Sleep Timer length (minutes)
sleepTimerMinutes.description: How long the aircon keeps running after you turn on the Sleep Timer tile.

pollSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often changes made on the tablet show up in Apple Home. The tablet copes poorly with very frequent requests.

aircon.title: Aircon key
aircon.description: Leave as ac1 unless the tablet runs more than one aircon.
